recall_additions.source: recall probe: Wikipedia insource sweep and the UK officer graph
recall_additions.basis: Wikipedia: 'After being denied funding by UK banks, Wonga secured venture capital through Balderton Capital'; Bernard Liautaud was a director of Wonga Group Limited (Companies House 05897177) from 2009-01-27 to 2018-09-06, inside his tenure. The live list omits the company, which went into administration in August 2018.

recall_additions.name: Touch Local
recall_additions.source: recall probe: exit-side EDGAR full-text sweep
recall_additions.basis: Web.com's 2014 registration statement: it bought 100% of Touch Local Limited (Scoot) under a share purchase agreement of 2014-07-31 'by and among Web.com Group, Inc., Balderton Capital III, LP, Mark Livingstone and Gary Dannatt, collectively the selling stockholders'; Mark Evans was a director of Touch Local Limited (Companies House 02885607) from 2006-10-26 to 2008-08-19. The Web.com shares Balderton received are sale consideration, not a row.
